format.description: The version of this file format. Always 1.

id.description: A name for this photo, like "moss". It matches the file name.

image.description: The photo's PNG, as a path from the game's root, like "content/photos/moss.png".

w.description: How many tiles wide the photo looks, like 1.

h.description: How many tiles tall the photo looks, like 1.

size.description: How big the photo looks beside a tile. 1 by 1 is one tile.

source.description: Where the photo came from: a name or a link.

credit.description: Who made the photo, as they want to be named.
